option_relations.rationale: Infectious endophthalmitis caused by Streptococcus intermedius is a subtype of Streptococcal endophthalmitis
No direct relation to Streptococcal endophthalmitis, as it involves multiple bacteria
Fungal endophthalmitis is a different condition, not related to Streptococcal endophthalmitis
Endogenous endophthalmitis with iris abscess is a different condition, not related to Streptococcal endophthalmitis
